guesses.reason: The long, shaggy coat with dark-tipped ears, the beard-like muzzle furnishings, the dark round eyes, and the small, sturdy build all point strongly to Shih Tzu ancestry.
The wavy-to-curly, soft-looking coat texture, especially on the head and legs, suggests a Poodle contribution, as in a Shih-Poo.
The gold-and-grizzle coloring with darker ear fringes and the long, dense, drop-eared coat resemble a Lhasa Apso.

breed.appearance: A small, compact dog with a long, scruffy, wavy-to-curly coat, shown slightly damp, in a mix of wheaten gold, tan, and pale cream, with grizzled silvery tips on the head. The long drop ears are fringed with darker charcoal-brown hair, and the face has a shaggy beard and mustache around a broad black nose. Large, round, dark brown eyes peek out from under a tousled topknot, giving a soulful, slightly scruffy look.
breed.fun_fact: Shih Tzus were bred as cherished companions for Chinese royalty, so this little one comes with a lap-dog pedigree fit for a palace!
